responsibility: Implements type checking for Rust patterns against an expected parent type. It resolves path, tuple-struct, struct, tuple, wildcard, literal, range, and identifier patterns, verifies that enum or struct variants have the expected shape and field counts, assigns field types into nested pattern nodes, and unifies bound expressions within range patterns so later match and let checking can rely on concrete TyTy pattern types.
same_name_distinction: Implements the pattern-type-checking visitor bodies, resolving pattern paths through expression checking, validating tuple/struct variant shape, propagating field types into nested patterns, and unifying range bounds. Unlike rust-hir-type-check-pattern.h, this file contains the operational checks rather than just the pattern visitor interface.
